claims.draft:
Subject: Expense claim VAL-001 cannot be paid as submitted

Hello Member 001,

Your claim VAL-001 for IDR 46,000 cannot be paid as submitted. The receipt total is IDR 23,000, so the claim is IDR 23,000 higher than the receipt. Under clause C4, a claim for more than the receipt total is rejected.

We also found that you claimed 2 x Kopi Susu Kolonel, but the receipt shows only 1 (receipt line: Kopi Susu Kolonel 1 23.000). The unit price of IDR 23,000 is above the agreed maximum of IDR 20,000 for es kopi susu.

To fix this, please resubmit the claim for IDR 23,000 or less, matching the receipt quantity. Any amount above the agreed maximum price may be questioned.

Thank you,
Club Treasurer
